nodes.label: Topical Retinoids
nodes.summary: Reviews vitamin A-derived topical retinoids: their pharmacology via nuclear RAR/RXR receptors, indications (acne, melasma/PIH, photo-aging) and adverse effects. Covers OTC retinol cosmeceuticals versus prescription tretinoin, adapalene and tazarotene.

nodes.label: Retinoids
nodes.summary: Natural or synthetic derivatives of vitamin A used topically or orally in dermatology to treat acne, psoriasis, pigmentary disorders and photo-aging; main side effect is irritation.

nodes.label: Vitamin A
nodes.summary: Exists as an aldehyde (retinal), alcohol (retinol) and carboxylic acid (retinoic acid), the latter being the active form in skin.

nodes.label: Tretinoin
nodes.summary: All-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), the first topical retinoid, marketed in the 1970s as Retin-A for acne; FDA-approved for fine wrinkles, mottled hyperpigmentation and roughness of photoaged skin.

nodes.label: Retinol
nodes.summary: Main OTC vitamin A derivative and 'original cosmeceutical', typically used at 1-2% though benefits seen at 0.1%; less irritating but less effective than prescription retinoids.

nodes.label: Retinal
nodes.summary: Aldehyde form of vitamin A.

nodes.label: Retinyl Esters
nodes.summary: Storage form of retinol in cells and dietary form of vitamin A metabolized to retinol.

nodes.label: Adapalene
nodes.summary: Synthetic retinoid (Differin) FDA-approved for acne.

nodes.label: Tazarotene
nodes.summary: Synthetic retinoid (Tazorac) FDA-approved for acne.

nodes.label: Retinoic Acid Receptors (RAR/RXR)
nodes.summary: Nuclear receptors (RAR and RXR, each with alpha, beta, gamma subtypes) bound by retinoids to modulate DNA transcription; RAR-gamma is the key mediator in skin.

nodes.label: Acne
nodes.summary: Pathogenesis involves plugged follicles, inflammation, P. acnes and excess sebum; the microcomedo is the initial lesion.

nodes.label: Microcomedo
nodes.summary: Initial lesion of acne, prevented by retinoids decreasing debris retention in follicles.

nodes.label: Propionibacterium acnes
nodes.summary: Bacterium involved in acne pathogenesis; topical retinoids do not directly reduce its counts.

nodes.label: Toll-Like Receptor 2
nodes.summary: Receptor inhibited by retinoids, down-regulating inflammatory mediators NF-kB, IL-8 and IL-20.

nodes.label: Melasma
nodes.summary: Hyperpigmentation disorder best managed by combination hydroquinone, tretinoin and topical steroid therapy.

nodes.label: Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation
nodes.summary: Pigmentary disorder for which retinoids are adjunctive treatment with bleaching agents.

nodes.label: Hydroquinone
nodes.summary: Skin-bleaching agent combined with tretinoin (which enhances its penetration) and a steroid for melasma.

nodes.label: Tyrosinase
nodes.summary: Melanogenic enzyme whose transcription is blocked by retinoids.

nodes.label: Photo-Aging
nodes.summary: Skin damage from chronic sun exposure: epidermal thinning, dysplasia, wrinkles, mottled pigmentation; ameliorated by topical retinoids.

nodes.label: Collagen
nodes.summary: Dermal structural protein; retinoids increase new collagen formation.

nodes.label: Skin Irritation
nodes.summary: Main side effect of topical retinoids: redness, scaling, dryness, itching, stinging and burning.

nodes.label: UV Radiation
nodes.summary: Retinoid use increases sensitivity to ultraviolet radiation so sunscreen is recommended.

nodes.label: Sunscreen
nodes.summary: Recommended during topical retinoid use due to increased UV sensitivity.

nodes.label: Psoriasis
nodes.summary: Skin condition among retinoid indications.

nodes.label: Hyperpigmentation
nodes.summary: Pigmentary disorders treated adjunctively by retinoids via tyrosinase blocking, desquamation and increased turnover.

nodes.label: Wrinkles
nodes.summary: Fine facial wrinkles are an FDA-approved indication for tretinoin.

nodes.label: FDA
nodes.summary: US Food and Drug Administration; approved tretinoin, adapalene and tazarotene for acne and tretinoin for photoaging.

nodes.label: Peptides for Anti-Aging Skin Care
nodes.summary: Explains what peptides are, their categories (signal/matrikine, antioxidant, neuropeptide, carrier, enzyme inhibitor) and marketed cosmetic peptides such as Matrixyl, Argireline and copper GHK. Discusses delivery challenges and chemical modifications like palmitoylation and cyclization.

nodes.label: Peptides
nodes.summary: Chains of at least two amino acids joined by peptide (amide) bonds; active at very low concentrations, with bioactivity determined by sequence; popular anti-aging cosmeceuticals since the early 1990s.

nodes.label: Peptide Bond
nodes.summary: Amide bond formed when the carboxyl group of one amino acid links to the amino group of the next, releasing water.

nodes.label: Amino Acids
nodes.summary: Building blocks of peptides and proteins; peptides break down into natural amino acids, conferring safety.

nodes.label: Cosmeceutical
nodes.summary: Term coined by Albert Kligman for effective ingredients between drug and cosmetic; not a regulatory category defined by FDA.

nodes.label: Extracellular Matrix
nodes.summary: Network of proteins (collagens, laminin, fibronectin, elastin, proteoglycans) anchoring cells and mediating receptor-induced signaling.

nodes.label: Elastin
nodes.summary: ECM protein of the dermal supporting matrix; source of matrikines.

nodes.label: Integrins
nodes.summary: Cell-surface receptors mediating ECM signaling; RGD peptides target integrin receptors.

nodes.label: Matrikines
nodes.summary: Signal peptides released by enzymatic degradation of ECM proteins that act as cell messengers in wound healing and tissue repair; natural and cryptic classes.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Pentapeptide (Matrixyl)
nodes.summary: Pal-KTTKS (lysine-threonine-threonine-lysine-serine) by Sederma; 50 ppm significantly reduced periorbital lines vs vehicle; stimulates collagen I, III, IV, fibronectin, elastin and GAG production.

nodes.label: Reactive Oxygen Species
nodes.summary: Damage cells by oxidizing membrane phospholipids, proteins and nucleic acids; controlled by endogenous antioxidant systems.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Paradox
nodes.summary: Clinical trials of antioxidants like vitamin E or SOD in humans largely failed despite animal efficacy, possibly due to pro-oxidant activity or failure to reach sites.

nodes.label: Superoxide Dismutase
nodes.summary: Endogenous antioxidant enzyme; large protein that cannot penetrate cell membranes.

nodes.label: Glutathione
nodes.summary: Endogenous antioxidant controlling ROS damage.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Peptides
nodes.summary: Peptide category addressing ROS-mediated damage.

nodes.label: Neuropeptides
nodes.summary: Peptides released from cutaneous and immune cells in response to stress; regulate cutaneous immune response, itch, pain, pigmentation and inflammation.

nodes.label: Carrier Peptides
nodes.summary: Peptides facilitating transport of trace elements such as copper and manganese, important for wound healing and enzymatic processes.

nodes.label: Copper Tripeptide (GHK-Cu)
nodes.summary: Gly-His-Lys tripeptide identified in human plasma in the 1970s with high Cu2+ affinity; signaling and copper carrier peptide shown to stimulate wound healing and reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

nodes.label: Enzyme Inhibitor Peptides
nodes.summary: Peptides that directly or indirectly inhibit enzymes, e.g., ACE-inhibiting di- and tripeptides.

nodes.label: Dipeptide-2
nodes.summary: ACE-inhibiting dipeptide marketed by Sederma as Peptide VW for anti-aging.

nodes.label: Acetyl Hexapeptide-3 (Argireline)
nodes.summary: SNAP-25-derived neurotransmitter-inhibiting peptide with Botox-like effect via SNARE inhibition; anti-wrinkle.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Tripeptide (Syn-Coll)
nodes.summary: Thrombospondin I-derived signal peptide promoting collagen synthesis via TGF-beta; anti-wrinkle and stretch-mark claims.

nodes.label: Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate (Syn-Ake)
nodes.summary: Synthetic peptide mimicking Waglerin 1 from Temple Viper venom; Botox-like via acetylcholine receptor.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Oligopeptide (Pal-GHK)
nodes.summary: Collagen-derived signal peptide (Biopeptide-CL) that stimulates collagen and glycosaminoglycan synthesis.

nodes.label: Cyclotetrapeptide-24 Aminocyclohexane Carboxylate
nodes.summary: Cyclic biomimetic RGD-containing peptide (RonaCare Cyclopeptide-5, Merck KGaA) with synthetic ACHA; claimed to improve wrinkles via integrin selectivity.

nodes.label: RGD Sequence
nodes.summary: Arginine-glycine-aspartic acid sequence that facilitates wound healing by binding receptors signaling collagen renewal.

nodes.label: Palmitoylation
nodes.summary: Adding a palmitoyl fatty-acid group to a water-soluble peptide to increase lipophilicity and penetration of the stratum corneum.

nodes.label: Skin Penetration
nodes.summary: Peptide permeability depends on pKa, molecular size, binding affinity, solubility and partition coefficient; a key formulation challenge.

nodes.label: Stratum Corneum
nodes.summary: Lipophilic outer skin barrier limiting peptide penetration.

nodes.label: Wound Healing
nodes.summary: Tissue repair process stimulated by matrikines, copper peptides and RGD peptides.

nodes.label: Botulinum Toxin
nodes.summary: Reference for 'Botox-like' neurotransmitter-inhibiting peptides.

nodes.label: Proteases
nodes.summary: Skin enzymes that degrade peptides, limiting their stability.

nodes.label: Glycosaminoglycans
nodes.summary: ECM components whose synthesis is stimulated by signal peptides.

nodes.label: Fibronectin
nodes.summary: ECM protein stimulated by Matrixyl.

nodes.label: TGF-beta
nodes.summary: Growth factor through which palmitoyl tripeptide drives collagen synthesis.

nodes.label: SNARE Complex
nodes.summary: Neurotransmitter release machinery inhibited by Argireline.

nodes.label: Sederma
nodes.summary: Company that introduced Matrixyl and Peptide VW.

nodes.label: MicroRNAs in Skin Physiology
nodes.summary: Introduces microRNA biology (discovery, nomenclature, biogenesis, RISC-mediated silencing) and reviews microRNA roles in epidermal differentiation, pigmentation, dermal fibroblasts, adipocytes, hair follicles and senescence. Discusses use of reconstructed skin models to evaluate anti-aging ingredients via microRNA studies.

nodes.label: MicroRNAs
nodes.summary: Small double-stranded noncoding RNAs of 20-25 nucleotides that bind the 3'UTR of target mRNAs causing translational repression or degradation; may target 30-60% of human transcripts.

nodes.label: Noncoding RNAs
nodes.summary: RNAs transcribed from noncoding DNA (about 43% of noncoding DNA is transcribed), including siRNAs, miRNAs, piRNAs, snoRNAs and lncRNAs.

nodes.label: RNA Interference
nodes.summary: Inhibition of gene expression by small double-stranded RNAs, described by Fire and Mello in C. elegans in 1998 (Nobel Prize 2006).

nodes.label: Small Interfering RNAs
nodes.summary: Small dsRNAs arising from exogenous long RNA precursors (viruses, transposons, plasmids) or applied synthetically, mediating RNAi.

nodes.label: MicroRNA Biogenesis
nodes.summary: Multi-step pathway: transcription to pri-miR, Drosha-DGCR8 microprocessor cleavage to pre-miR, Exportin-5 export, DICER1/TRBP processing to a duplex and loading into RISC.

nodes.label: Drosha
nodes.summary: Nuclear RNase III that with DGCR8 forms the microprocessor cleaving pri-microRNAs into pre-microRNAs.

nodes.label: DICER1
nodes.summary: Cytoplasmic RNase III that processes pre-microRNAs into 20-25 nt duplexes; its knockout in mouse skin disrupts epidermal and hair follicle morphogenesis and causes premature senescence.

nodes.label: Exportin-5
nodes.summary: Karyopherin (XPO5) mediating nuclear export of pre-microRNAs with cofactor Ran-GTP.

nodes.label: RNA-Induced Silencing Complex
nodes.summary: RISC composed of DICER1, TRBP and AGO2; guided by mature microRNA to degrade fully complementary mRNA or inhibit translation.

nodes.label: miRBase
nodes.summary: MicroRNA database; v10 (June 2013) listed 1872 human precursors and 2578 mature microRNAs.

nodes.label: miR-203
nodes.summary: Keratinocyte-specific microRNA, >100-fold higher in skin than other organs, forming a basal-low/suprabasal-high gradient; master regulator of epidermal differentiation, repressing stemness via DNp63.

nodes.label: p63 (DNp63)
nodes.summary: Transcription factor; DNp63 is master regulator of stratification maintaining epithelial stem cell proliferative potential; major miR-203 target.

nodes.label: Keratinocyte
nodes.summary: Main epidermal cell type whose differentiation is regulated by miR-203, miR-24 and others.

nodes.label: Keratinocyte Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Basal epidermal progenitors (<1% of basal population) residing in a niche, supporting epidermal renewal.
aliases: somatic stem cells of the epidermis

nodes.label: Epidermal Differentiation
nodes.summary: Coordinated multi-step process of keratinocyte maturation from basal proliferation to suprabasal differentiation, controlled by miR-203 among others.

nodes.label: Involucrin
nodes.summary: Cornified cell envelope protein in the stratum corneum; decreased upon miR-203 inhibition.

nodes.label: SOCS3
nodes.summary: Negative regulator of JAK/STAT pathway; controversial miR-203 target.

nodes.label: c-Jun
nodes.summary: Proto-oncogene expressed in basal epidermis targeted by miR-203; increased when miR-203 is suppressed in basal cell carcinoma.

nodes.label: ABL1
nodes.summary: Oncogene targeted by miR-203.

nodes.label: miR-24
nodes.summary: Suprabasal microRNA inducing differentiation by controlling actin adhesion dynamics; down-regulated in senescent fibroblasts with up-regulated target p16.

nodes.label: miR-200 / miR-205
nodes.summary: Highly expressed skin microRNAs targeting ZEB1/ZEB2, repressors of E-cadherin, maintaining epithelial stability.

nodes.label: E-Cadherin
nodes.summary: Epithelial adhesion protein repressed by ZEB1/ZEB2.

nodes.label: Melanocyte
nodes.summary: Synthesizes melanin in melanosomes transferred to keratinocytes forming a supranuclear cap protecting DNA from UV.

nodes.label: Melanin
nodes.summary: Pigment produced in melanosomes that protects genomic DNA from UV.

nodes.label: Melanosome
nodes.summary: Melanocyte organelle where melanin is synthesized and transferred to keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Melanogenesis
nodes.summary: Melanin synthesis regulated by melanogenic enzymes and transcriptional pathways potentially subject to microRNA silencing.

nodes.label: MITF
nodes.summary: Microphthalmia-associated transcription factor regulating melanogenesis enzyme genes; targeted by miR-25, miR-145 and miR-675.

nodes.label: miR-145
nodes.summary: MicroRNA whose increased expression targets Sox9, Mitf, Tyr, Trp1 and melanosome-transport genes, inducing depigmentation.

nodes.label: miR-125b
nodes.summary: Potent melanogenesis regulator inversely related to pigment levels, modulated by promoter methylation.

nodes.label: miR-675
nodes.summary: Secreted by keratinocytes in exosomes and regulates melanocyte pigmentation via MITF.

nodes.label: Exosomes
nodes.summary: Extracellular vesicles carrying microRNAs, mRNAs and proteins between cells; released by senescent cells and potential biomarkers.

nodes.label: Melanoma
nodes.summary: Dangerous melanocyte cancer with distinct microRNA signature; miR-203 down-regulation promotes melanogenesis and reduces melanosome transport.

nodes.label: Dermal Fibroblast
nodes.summary: Dermal cells secreting ECM; microRNAs regulate their senescence and ECM synthesis.

nodes.label: miR-29
nodes.summary: Family up-regulated in fibroblast senescence; miR-29b is a potent post-transcriptional repressor of collagen type I.

nodes.label: Scleroderma
nodes.summary: Autoimmune disease with excessive collagen deposition and fibrosis; associated with decreased let-7a, miR-150, miR-7 and increased miR-92a.

nodes.label: Keloids
nodes.summary: Scar tissue overgrowth from abnormal wound healing with fibroblast proliferation and collagen overproduction; differential microRNAs including up-regulated miR-21.

nodes.label: Matrix Metalloproteinases
nodes.summary: MMP1 is a major collagen-degrading protease targeted by miR-92a.

nodes.label: Adipocyte
nodes.summary: Hypodermal white adipose cells storing energy in lipid droplets; differentiation regulated by microRNAs.

nodes.label: Adipogenesis
nodes.summary: Differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells into pre-adipocytes and adipocytes, regulated by PPARg, C/EBP and microRNAs (miR-27b, miR-138, miR-22 inhibit; miR-30 promotes).

nodes.label: PPAR-gamma
nodes.summary: Key adipogenic nuclear receptor targeted by miR-27b and miR-130.

nodes.label: Hair Follicle
nodes.summary: Skin appendage cycling through anagen, catagen and telogen; Dicer deletion yields hypoproliferative follicles without hair shafts.

nodes.label: Hair Growth Cycle
nodes.summary: Cycles of growth (anagen), regression (catagen) and rest (telogen).

nodes.label: Androgenetic Alopecia
nodes.summary: Male pattern baldness with up-regulated miR-221, miR-125b, miR-106b and miR-410.

nodes.label: Vitiligo
nodes.summary: A miR-196a-2 mutation (rs11614913 C allele) may decrease vitiligo risk.

nodes.label: Intrinsic Aging
nodes.summary: Chronological aging from genetics, characterized by atrophic pale skin with fine wrinkles; mimicked in vitro by replicative senescence.

nodes.label: Extrinsic Aging
nodes.summary: Aging due to environmental factors, mainly UV, causing hypertrophic skin, irregular pigmentation and pronounced wrinkling.

nodes.label: Cellular Senescence
nodes.summary: Irreversible cell cycle arrest during aging regulated by p53-p21 and p16-pRB pathways; modulated by senescence-associated microRNAs.

nodes.label: p53-p21 Pathway
nodes.summary: Key senescence-regulating pathway modulated by microRNAs.

nodes.label: p16-pRB Pathway
nodes.summary: Senescence pathway; p16 is up-regulated when miR-24 declines.

nodes.label: miR-34a
nodes.summary: Tumor-suppressor senescence-associated microRNA up-regulated in replicative and H2O2-induced senescence; targets SIRT1 and E2F3.

nodes.label: SIRT1
nodes.summary: Sirtuin deacetylase regulating cell growth and apoptosis via p53; target of miR-34a.

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated MicroRNAs
nodes.summary: SA-miRs modulating senescence pathways; overlap with inflamma-miRs and onco-miRs.

nodes.label: Lamin B1
nodes.summary: Nuclear envelope constituent declining in senescent fibroblasts and keratinocytes, mediated by miR-23a.

nodes.label: Progeria
nodes.summary: Premature aging syndrome caused by lamin A mutations.

nodes.label: Reconstructed Skin Model
nodes.summary: 3D bioengineered epidermis or full-thickness skin from primary cells used as reproducible testing model for microRNA studies of anti-aging ingredients.

nodes.label: MicroRNA Expression Profiling
nodes.summary: Microarray, RNA sequencing, qPCR and qPCR arrays used to profile microRNA expression.

nodes.label: Epigenetics
nodes.summary: Regulation of gene expression including DNA methylation, histone modification and RNA-mediated silencing.

nodes.label: Amino Acids
nodes.summary: Covers production (fermentation, enzymatic, extraction), properties and derivatives of amino acids and their benefits against signs of skin and hair aging: wrinkling, elasticity, clarity, hydration, UV damage, hair breakage, dullness and roughness. Includes example cleanser, moisturizer, serum, shampoo and conditioner formulations.

nodes.label: Essential Amino Acids
nodes.summary: Amino acids not made sufficiently in the body (methionine, tryptophan, threonine, phenylalanine, valine, lysine, leucine, histidine, isoleucine) and obtained from diet.

nodes.label: Fermentation Method
nodes.summary: Main industrial amino acid production using screened microorganisms fed sugars, with 10-30 enzymes in sequence; enables low-cost mass production.

nodes.label: Monosodium Glutamate
nodes.summary: Isolated by Kikunae Ikeda in 1908 from seaweed/soy hydrolysates; birth of industrial amino acid production.

nodes.label: Glutamic Acid
nodes.summary: Amino acid that can be acylated into acyl glutamate surfactants, esterified into emollients or cyclized into PCA humectant.

nodes.label: Free Radicals
nodes.summary: Highly reactive molecules damaging membranes, lipids, proteins and DNA; excess is a top antagonist of skin and hair.

nodes.label: Natural Moisturizing Factor
nodes.summary: Humectant mixture in corneocytes: 40% amino acids, 12% PCA, 12% lactates, 7% urea plus other components.

nodes.label: Atopic Dermatitis
nodes.summary: Dry, flaky, itchy skin in which all standard amino acids in skin are significantly reduced.

nodes.label: Hyperkeratosis
nodes.summary: Condition in which amino acid conversion to metabolites is greatly decreased.

nodes.label: Zinc PCA
nodes.summary: Zinc pyrrolidone carboxylate; inhibits UV-induced AP-1 (3 ppm inhibited 69.3%, 30 ppm 77% in fibroblasts), preventing collagenase and wrinkle formation.

nodes.label: Activator Protein-1
nodes.summary: Transcription factor formed upon UV radiation that induces collagenase production.

nodes.label: Collagenase
nodes.summary: Enzyme degrading collagen, causing wrinkles; induced by AP-1.

nodes.label: Glycine
nodes.summary: Nonessential amino acid; part of collagen-boosting glycine:proline:alanine cocktail.

nodes.label: L-Proline
nodes.summary: Amino acid uniquely retaining moisture at low humidity, forming with leucine/isoleucine a lipid bilayer that inhibits moisture loss; boosts collagen in cocktail.

nodes.label: Alanine
nodes.summary: Amino acid in collagen-stimulating cocktail with glycine and proline.

nodes.label: Lysine
nodes.summary: Essential amino acid needed for collagen; lysine-poor diets may increase wrinkles.

nodes.label: Arginine
nodes.summary: Alkaline amino acid that raises pH of AHA/BHA products without reducing efficacy, smooths hair and neutralizes gel polymers.

nodes.label: Cysteine
nodes.summary: Powerful antioxidant amino acid that penetrates skin.

nodes.label: Methionine
nodes.summary: Antioxidant amino acid; stimulates connective tissue regeneration.

nodes.label: Taurine
nodes.summary: Antioxidant and free radical scavenger.

nodes.label: N-Acetyl Cysteine
nodes.summary: Powerful antioxidant that penetrates skin.

nodes.label: Sodium PCA
nodes.summary: Highly hygroscopic humectant from cyclized glutamic acid; plumps fine lines, dramatically increases skin elongation and smooths hair better than glycerin or butylene glycol.

nodes.label: Pyrrolidone Carboxylic Acid
nodes.summary: PCA; 12% of NMF, formed by cyclizing glutamic acid.

nodes.label: Sodium Polyaspartate
nodes.summary: Polymerized aspartic acid film former/humectant; 10% let skin stretch 5.75 mm vs 1.5 mm for hydrolyzed collagen; restores permed hair tensile strength.

nodes.label: Skin Elasticity
nodes.summary: Measured as elongation to break on Fudo rheometer; increased by sodium PCA and polyaspartate.

nodes.label: Fudo Rheometer
nodes.summary: Instrument stretching skin specimen at constant rate until break, similar to a universal testing machine.

nodes.label: Alpha Hydroxy Acids
nodes.summary: Keratolytic acids clarifying skin by removing dead cells; acidic and stinging.

nodes.label: Beta Hydroxy Acids
nodes.summary: Keratolytic clarifying acids whose stinging is reduced by pH adjustment.

nodes.label: Keratolytic
nodes.summary: Substance that softens keratin and loosens the horny layer so dead cells shed.

nodes.label: Skin Hydration
nodes.summary: Key to youthful appearance; correlates linearly with SC amino acid content.

nodes.label: Transepidermal Water Loss
nodes.summary: Reduced by amino acid-derived emollients, increasing hydration.

nodes.label: Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate
nodes.summary: Acyl glutamate anionic surfactant; 10% wash removes only 52% amino acids and 39% PCA vs 62%/56% for SLES and 70%/62% for soap.

nodes.label: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
nodes.summary: Anionic surfactant (SLES) that removes about 62% of SC amino acids at 10%; damages hair tensile strength when shampooing.

nodes.label: Soap
nodes.summary: Removes about 70% of SC amino acids and 62% PCA.

nodes.label: Amino Acid-Based Surfactants
nodes.summary: Acylated, neutralized amino acids (glutamates, glycinates, alaninates, sarcosinates) used as mild cleansing agents.

nodes.label: Phytosteryl/Octyldodecyl Lauroyl Glutamate
nodes.summary: Amino acid-derived emollient; 0.5% in shampoo restored bleached hair tensile strength to 95% and wets UV pigments.

nodes.label: Ceramides
nodes.summary: Type 3 ceramide compared to glutamate emollients in barrier recovery; ceramides leach from damaged hair.

nodes.label: Petrolatum
nodes.summary: Occlusive compared in barrier recovery test.

nodes.label: Sodium Lactate
nodes.summary: Humectant absorbing high moisture at high humidity.

nodes.label: Glycerin
nodes.summary: Humectant that left hair rougher than sodium PCA.

nodes.label: Butylene Glycol
nodes.summary: 1,3-butylene glycol humectant that increased hair roughness vs sodium PCA.

nodes.label: Humectants
nodes.summary: Hygroscopic materials supplying moisture to SC; e.g., sodium PCA, sodium lactate, proline, glycerin.

nodes.label: Isopropyl Lauroyl Sarcosinate
nodes.summary: Amino acid ester; excellent solvent for organic UVB absorbers and helps inorganic blockers spread.

nodes.label: Lauroyl Lysine
nodes.summary: Amino acid derivative helping inorganic UV blocks deposit uniformly with soft lubricious skin feel.

nodes.label: Titanium Dioxide
nodes.summary: Micronized inorganic UV blocker pigment wetted by glutamate derivatives.

nodes.label: Zinc Oxide
nodes.summary: Inorganic UV blocker pigment.

nodes.label: Keratin
nodes.summary: Hair protein composed of amino acids.

nodes.label: Cell Membrane Complex
nodes.summary: Glues cortex cells of hair together; contains amino acids.

nodes.label: Hair Breakage
nodes.summary: Results from tensile strength loss after perming (75-95%) and bleaching (90%); mitigated by amino acid derivatives.

nodes.label: Hair Tensile Strength
nodes.summary: Measure of hair strength reduced by perming, bleaching and shampooing.

nodes.label: Hair Bleaching
nodes.summary: Ammoniated peroxide bleaching reduces hair tensile strength.

nodes.label: Permanent Waving
nodes.summary: Perming with ammonium thioglycolate neutralized by sodium bromide reduces tensile strength.

nodes.label: Hair Dullness
nodes.summary: Sign of aged hair addressed with oils, esters, silicones and amino acid cocktails.

nodes.label: Lauroyl Arginine
nodes.summary: Amphoteric amino acid surfactant aligning hair fibers, reducing frizz and increasing luster.

nodes.label: PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate
nodes.summary: Amino acid cationic conditioning agent (CAE) giving greater bending strength (bounce) than STAC or DSTMAC and repairing cuticle.

nodes.label: Hair Cuticle
nodes.summary: Outer hair layer damaged by washing; repaired by CAE.

nodes.label: Hair Roughness
nodes.summary: Measured by sensory and dynamic friction coefficient; reduced by sodium PCA and arginine.

nodes.label: Dynamic Friction Coefficient
nodes.summary: Measure of friction forces between solids; used for hair combing smoothness.

nodes.label: Shampoo
nodes.summary: Hair cleanser; example formulas with acyl glutamates, lauroyl lysine and zinc PCA.

nodes.label: Hair Conditioner
nodes.summary: Hair care product; amino acid derivatives improve tensile strength (to 93%).

nodes.label: Facial Cleanser
nodes.summary: Skin cleanser formulated with amino acid surfactants.

nodes.label: Moisturizer
nodes.summary: Skin care formulated with amino acid emollients and humectants.

nodes.label: Serum
nodes.summary: Skin care product example with amino acid cocktail and hyaluronic acid.

nodes.label: Hyaluronic Acid
nodes.summary: Hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid used in serums and shampoos.

nodes.label: Ajinomoto
nodes.summary: Amino acid manufacturer providing technical data cited.

nodes.label: AHAs and Beyond: Anti-Aging Ingredients
nodes.summary: Reviews alpha-hydroxy acids (glycolic, lactic, citric, mandelic) and their clinical and mechanistic effects across stratum corneum, epidermis and dermis, then second- and third-generation polyhydroxy and bionic acids, N-acetylamino sugars and N-acetylamino acids. Details low-pH formulation strategies (pKa, thickeners, emulsifiers, amphoteric complexes) to balance efficacy and irritation.

nodes.label: Glycolic Acid
nodes.summary: Smallest AHA (2-hydroxyethanoic acid, ~76 Da, pKa 3.8) from sugar cane; 8% cream (pH 3.8) improved crepey photodamaged skin in 15/16 studies and stimulates collagen synthesis.

nodes.label: Lactic Acid
nodes.summary: 3-carbon AHA from milk, endogenous metabolite; thickens epidermis (5-12%), stimulates ceramide synthesis and VEGF secretion.

nodes.label: Citric Acid
nodes.summary: Polycarboxyl acid that is both AHA and BHA; found in citrus and the Krebs cycle; antioxidant; 20% increased epidermal thickness and dermal GAGs.

nodes.label: Mandelic Acid
nodes.summary: Aromatic lipophilic AHA (phenylglycolic acid) with affinity for sebum, useful for oily and acne-prone skin.

nodes.label: Polyhydroxy Acids
nodes.summary: Second-generation AHAs (aldonic acids) with multiple hydroxyls; comparable anti-aging benefits with greater mildness, humectancy, antioxidant and barrier benefits.

nodes.label: Gluconolactone
nodes.summary: Most common PHA, from corn sugar; equivalent to glycolic acid on aging attributes with less irritation; chelates metals inhibiting MMPs, reduces UV elastin promoter activation by 50%, and strengthens barrier against SLS.

nodes.label: Bionic Acids
nodes.summary: Third-generation AHAs (aldobionic acids): a monosaccharide linked to an aldonic acid; ~358 Da; very hygroscopic, antioxidant, metal chelating and MMP-inhibiting.

nodes.label: Lactobionic Acid
nodes.summary: Bionic acid of gluconic acid linked to galactose (milk sugar); 8% pH 3.8 matched glycolic acid in anti-aging benefits, reduced MMP9 and alpha-MSH-induced melanin.

nodes.label: Maltobionic Acid
nodes.summary: Bionic acid of gluconic acid linked to glucose; increased cell turnover 82% in eight days, reduces lipid peroxidation, nonirritating at 20%.

nodes.label: Ichthyosis
nodes.summary: Genetic hyperkeratotic disorders with dry scaling skin; first AHA indication.

nodes.label: Stratum Disjunctum
nodes.summary: Outermost desquamating layer of SC where glycolic acid accelerates desmosome breakdown.

nodes.label: Corneodesmosomes
nodes.summary: Proteins binding corneocytes; AHAs degrade them to decrease cohesion and enhance desquamation.

nodes.label: Desquamation
nodes.summary: Shedding of corneocytes; AHAs enhance it possibly via pH activation of acid proteases such as kallikreins and cathepsin D.

nodes.label: Kallikreins
nodes.summary: Family of 15 serine proteases (KLK1-15) in SC; KLK-7 is a candidate desquamation protease.

nodes.label: Skin Barrier
nodes.summary: SC permeability barrier improved by gluconolactone and lactobionic acid lowering SC pH.

nodes.label: Interleukin-1 Alpha
nodes.summary: Cytokine released by GA-treated keratinocytes that up-regulates fibroblast MMP-1/3 and induces IL-6.

nodes.label: VEGF
nodes.summary: Vascular growth factor whose secretion is increased by 1.5-3% lactic acid, possibly explaining AHA microvascular effects.

nodes.label: TRPV1
nodes.summary: Acid-sensitive ion channel mediating glycolic acid-induced keratinocyte proliferation and ATP release; TRPV channels may underlie AHA stinging.

nodes.label: Aerobic Metabolism
nodes.summary: AHAs stimulate Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation in keratinocytes and fibroblasts, increasing ATP for proliferation and collagen synthesis.

nodes.label: Solar Lentigines
nodes.summary: Small brown patches treated by AHAs.

nodes.label: Solar Elastosis
nodes.summary: Dermal matrix damage from chronic photoaging exacerbated by UV-induced elastin promoter activation.

nodes.label: Ascorbic Acid
nodes.summary: Vitamin C protectant comparable to gluconolactone in reducing UV elastin promoter activation.

nodes.label: Tocopherol
nodes.summary: Vitamin E protectant comparable to gluconolactone.

nodes.label: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
nodes.summary: Irritant (SLS) used to challenge skin barrier.

nodes.label: Rosacea
nodes.summary: Sensitive skin condition compatible with gluconolactone.

nodes.label: pKa
nodes.summary: Negative log of acid dissociation constant; at pH = pKa half the AHA is free acid (10% glycolic at pH 3.8 gives 5% bioavailable).

nodes.label: Free Acid Bioavailability
nodes.summary: Only undissociated free acid penetrates skin; formulation pH is the most important factor for AHA efficacy.

nodes.label: Amphoteric AHA Complex
nodes.summary: AHA complexed with arginine or ornithine for slow release; 20% glycolic/arginine took 11 vs 4 days to moderate irritation while 6.3% complex cut SC turnover time 15.7%.

nodes.label: Smectite Clays
nodes.summary: Thickeners forming house-of-cards colloidal structure giving thixotropy and yield value in low-pH formulas.

nodes.label: Polyacrylic Acid Polymers
nodes.summary: Hydro swellable droplet polymers that invert in water for instant viscosity with broad pH stability.

nodes.label: Acid-Swellable Associative Thickeners
nodes.summary: Acrylic amine polymers that swell when protonated by acids, thickening low-pH formulas.

nodes.label: Xanthan Gum
nodes.summary: Natural pH-stable thickener in auxiliary role.

nodes.label: Emulsion
nodes.summary: O/W, W/O and W/Si emulsions; low-pH AHA emulsions are difficult to stabilize.

nodes.label: Nonionic Emulsifiers
nodes.summary: Best for low-pH O/W emulsions, combined low/high HLB with long-chain fatty alcohol.

nodes.label: Hydrophilic-Lipophilic Balance
nodes.summary: HLB study determines emulsifier ratio for stability.

nodes.label: N-Acetylglucosamine
nodes.summary: Neutral amino sugar (NAG), component of GAGs, chitin and hyaluronic acid; 8% cream raised skin thickness 16.2% and pinch recoil 12.2%, inhibits tyrosinase glycosylation and synergizes with retinoic acid on HA (2.5-fold).

nodes.label: Chitin
nodes.summary: Natural polymer of repeating N-acetylglucosamine units in crustacean shells.

nodes.label: Benzoyl Peroxide
nodes.summary: 10% anti-acne agent compared to NAG; more effective later but less tolerable.

nodes.label: N-Acetyl Amino Acids
nodes.summary: Amino acid derivatives structurally analogous to AHAs; e.g., N-acetylcysteine, N-acetylhydroxyproline, N-acetyltyrosinamide.

nodes.label: N-Acetyltyrosinamide
nodes.summary: Increases HA, collagen-1 and elastin in fibroblasts; raised skin thickness 13% in 8 weeks; regimen improved nasolabial folds 10.3% and crow's feet 17.8%.

nodes.label: N-Acetylhydroxyproline
nodes.summary: Converts to hydroxyproline (a collagen amino acid) in skin and improves barrier function.

nodes.label: Ballistometry
nodes.summary: Diastron pendulum instrument measuring skin indentation, rebound and elasticity (damping coefficient).

nodes.label: 3D Facial Scanning
nodes.summary: Cyberware 3030 HIREZ near-IR scanner computing length, depth and volume of wrinkles.

nodes.label: Dansyl Chloride Assay
nodes.summary: In vivo fluorescent assay measuring SC cell turnover rate.

nodes.label: Photo-Damaged Arm Model
nodes.summary: Bilateral paired forearm clinical model grading crepe-like appearance on 0-9 scale.

nodes.label: Optical Coherence Tomography
nodes.summary: Imaging used to show epidermal thickness improvement.

nodes.label: Repeat Insult Patch Test
nodes.summary: Showed 20% maltobionic acid cream nonallergenic and nonirritating.

nodes.label: Skin Surface pH
nodes.summary: SC pH regulates barrier homeostasis, integrity and antimicrobial defense; elevated in impaired skin and lowered by LBA and gluconolactone.

nodes.label: Cytokines, Growth Factors, and Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Discusses intrinsic and extrinsic aging and newer cosmeceuticals: topical growth factors and cytokines (TGF-beta1, neonatal/fetal fibroblast secretions) and stem cell extracts from adipose tissue and plants such as the Uttwiler Spatlauber apple. Covers efficacy, penetration and safety concerns including VEGF and cancer.

nodes.label: Tissue Inhibitors of Metalloproteinases
nodes.summary: Endogenous MMP inhibitors that free radicals inhibit.

nodes.label: Growth Factors
nodes.summary: Wound-healing proteins secreted by fibroblasts, keratinocytes and melanocytes that increase fibroblast/keratinocyte proliferation and ECM; large hydrophilic molecules with limited penetration.

nodes.label: Cytokines
nodes.summary: Immune-regulating secreted factors also involved in skin repair; combined with growth factors in topical products.

nodes.label: Aging as Chronic Wound Hypothesis
nodes.summary: Hypothesis that skin aging resembles a chronic wound, justifying growth factor supplementation.

nodes.label: Neonatal Dermal Fibroblast Conditioned Media
nodes.summary: Neonatal fibroblasts secrete over 110 growth factors, cytokines and matrix proteins; decreased wrinkles and increased epidermal thickness lasting 3 months after stopping.

nodes.label: Processed Skin-Cell Proteins
nodes.summary: PSP from cultured fetal dermal fibroblasts with >100 growth factors and cytokines; reduced periorbital/perioral wrinkles and dark circles.

nodes.label: Dark Under-Eye Circles
nodes.summary: Reduced by PSP, possibly via increased collagen thickening skin over vessels.

nodes.label: Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Cells that self-renew and differentiate; their extracts contain growth factors and cytokines used in serums and creams.

nodes.label: Adipose-Derived Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Mesenchymal stem cells from human fat; conditioned media (ASC-CM) promote collagen, decrease MMP-1, protect against UVB oxidative stress, inhibit melanogenesis and lighten skin.

nodes.label: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Abundant in adipose tissue; regenerate damaged skin.

nodes.label: Plant Stem Cells
nodes.summary: Cultured plant cell extracts (apple, jasmine, lilac); distinct from extracts of plant stems.

nodes.label: Uttwiler Spatlauber Apple Stem Cell Extract
nodes.summary: Swiss apple stem cell extract; 2% delayed senescence in H2O2-treated fibroblasts, prolonged hair follicle growth phase by 4 days and reduced wrinkles in two weeks.

nodes.label: Oxidative Stress
nodes.summary: UVB-induced oxidative stress in fibroblasts prevented by ASCs.

nodes.label: Tyrosinase-Related Protein 1
nodes.summary: Melanin enzyme TRP1 down-regulated by ASC-CM.

nodes.label: Skin Lightening
nodes.summary: ASCs lighten skin dose-dependently, of interest in Eastern markets.

nodes.label: Allergic Reaction
nodes.summary: Potential risk of growth factors in hypersensitive patients.

nodes.label: Antioxidants in Cosmetics for Anti-Aging
nodes.summary: Covers causes of UV-induced oxidative damage (photosensitizers, ROS/RNS, NADPH oxidase, free metals), the skin's endogenous antioxidant network, and consequences for MMPs, ECM and the dermal-epidermal junction. Reviews conventional and nonconventional antioxidants (tocopherol, vitamin C, carotenoids, polyphenols, emblica, resveratrol, bakuchiol, retinoids, hexylresorcinol, antioxidant-photostabilizers) and combinations.

nodes.label: Antioxidants
nodes.summary: Substances that at low concentration significantly delay or prevent oxidation of a substrate (Halliwell and Gutteridge); quench free radicals and can slow signs of aging.

nodes.label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
nodes.summary: Longer-lived, more specific species; NO plus superoxide forms peroxynitrite, triggering cytochrome c release and caspase-mediated apoptosis.

nodes.label: Singlet Oxygen
nodes.summary: First ROS formed from triplet excited endogenous photosensitizers under UVA; initiates lipid peroxidation; also generated by organic sunscreens acting as triplet sensitizers.

nodes.label: Endogenous Photosensitizers
nodes.summary: Skin chromophores (porphyrins, riboflavin, ubiquinone, NADH/NADPH, trans-urocanic acid) that generate ROS under UVA.

nodes.label: Hydroxyl Radical
nodes.summary: Highly toxic radical generated from hydrogen peroxide with Fe2+ (Fenton reaction).

nodes.label: Fenton Reaction
nodes.summary: Iron-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals from hydrogen peroxide.

nodes.label: Lipid Peroxidation
nodes.summary: Oxidation of lipids initiated by singlet oxygen and hydroxyl radicals.

nodes.label: Apoptosis
nodes.summary: Programmed cell death via apoptosome and caspase-3/7 activation triggered by peroxynitrite oxidative stress.

nodes.label: NADPH Oxidase
nodes.summary: 'Professional' ROS-producing enzyme (Nox1) and major source of UVA-induced ROS in keratinocytes and fibroblasts; activated by intracellular calcium and ceramide.

nodes.label: Free Iron and Copper
nodes.summary: Catalytic transition metals released from ferritin by UVB superoxide and from sweat; drive iron-catalyzed oxidative stress and NF-kB activation.

nodes.label: Iron-Chelating Agents
nodes.summary: Protect against UV-induced free radical production.

nodes.label: Pro-Oxidant Activity
nodes.summary: Antioxidants like vitamin C, E, glutathione and carotenoids can act as pro-oxidants especially with transition metals; vitamin C's pro-oxidant action helps convert proline to hydroxyproline.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Network
nodes.summary: Skin's interlinked defense of enzymes and non-enzymatic antioxidants maintaining pro-oxidant/antioxidant balance; can be overwhelmed by exogenous ROS.

nodes.label: Catalase
nodes.summary: Enzyme converting hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen; significantly decreased in aged dermis.

nodes.label: Glutathione Peroxidase
nodes.summary: Enzyme removing hydrogen peroxide; up-regulated by resveratrol and 4-hexylresorcinol.

nodes.label: Ubiquinone
nodes.summary: Lipophilic endogenous antioxidant (coenzyme Q) and photosensitizer.

nodes.label: Uric Acid
nodes.summary: Hydrophilic endogenous antioxidant in skin.

nodes.label: Tocopheryl Esters
nodes.summary: Tocopherol acetate, succinate and linoleate; less protective than tocopherol due to slow hydrolysis in skin.

nodes.label: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
nodes.summary: Stable vitamin C derivative (MAP), like sodium ascorbyl phosphate requiring pH >7 and a chelator.

nodes.label: Ascorbyl Glucoside
nodes.summary: Ascorbic acid 2-O-alpha-D-glucoside; stable in acidic environments with improved stability and efficacy.

nodes.label: Carotenoids
nodes.summary: Lipophilic plant pigments (beta-carotene, lycopene, lutein) reacting with almost any radical; UV lowers skin lycopene 31-46%; beta-carotene supplementation linked to cancer in smokers.

nodes.label: Plant Polyphenols
nodes.summary: Plant antioxidants (flavonoids, tannins, catechols); reduce UV skin damage; inherently unstable.

nodes.label: Green Tea Polyphenols
nodes.summary: Camellia sinensis catechins (EGCG, EGC, EC) quenching multiple ROS; reduce UV erythema, sunburn cells, Langerhans cell depletion and pyrimidine dimers.

nodes.label: Emblica Antioxidant
nodes.summary: Standardized Phyllanthus emblica fruit extract rich in emblicanins A/B; stable, chelates iron/copper without pro-oxidant activity, inhibits MMPs, increases collagen, lightens skin and reduces fine lines.

nodes.label: Resveratrol
nodes.summary: Polyphenolic stilbene from red wine/Polygonum cuspidatum; SIRT1 activator extending yeast lifespan 70%; up-regulates glutathione enzymes; not photostable.

nodes.label: Bakuchiol
nodes.summary: Phenolic meroterpene; psoralen-depleted Sytenol A (~95%) is non-sensitizing; inhibits lipid peroxidation, NF-kB, HIF-1 and iNOS; radical scavenging above vitamin E; retinol-like gene expression; 1% eliminated UV erythema; improves acne and aging signs; stabilizes retinol.

nodes.label: Alkylresorcinols
nodes.summary: Phenolic lipids from whole-grain rye and wheat; weak antioxidants but strong inhibitors of Fe2+/H2O2 oxidation; antitumor and antimicrobial.

nodes.label: 4-Hexylresorcinol
nodes.summary: Alkylresorcinol used 80+ years (throat lozenges, GRAS anti-browning); tyrosinase/peroxidase inhibitor superior to hydroquinone and kojic acid; increases glutathione enzymes; anti-glycation (Synovea HR).

nodes.label: Kojic Acid
nodes.summary: Skin lightener outperformed by hexylresorcinol.

nodes.label: Glycation
nodes.summary: Process inhibited by 4-hexylresorcinol.

nodes.label: Diethylhexyl Syringylidene Malonate
nodes.summary: Antioxidant photostabilizer designed by Chaudhuri that stabilizes avobenzone, with antioxidant activity superior to vitamin E.

nodes.label: Avobenzone
nodes.summary: Photosensitive UVA filter stabilized by antioxidant-photostabilizers such as DESM, HMBP and TMP.

nodes.label: Antioxidant-Photostabilizers
nodes.summary: Photostabilizers with built-in antioxidant function (DESM, HMBP, TMP pentanedione derivatives) that stabilize avobenzone and protect skin.

nodes.label: Dermal-Epidermal Junction
nodes.summary: Four-zone interface (hemidesmosomes, lamina lucida with laminin 5, lamina densa with collagen IV, anchoring fibrils of collagen VII); flattens with loss of rete pegs in aging.

nodes.label: Collagen VII
nodes.summary: Anchoring fibril collagen decreasing with aging; biochemical marker of wrinkles.

nodes.label: Collagen IV
nodes.summary: Lamina densa collagen decreasing after age 35.

nodes.label: Skin Cancer
nodes.summary: Most severe consequence of photo-oxidative damage.

nodes.label: Erythema
nodes.summary: UV-induced redness reduced by green tea polyphenols, emblica, bakuchiol and vitamin C/E combinations.

nodes.label: NF-kB
nodes.summary: Transcription factor activated after UVA by iron release; inhibited by bakuchiol.

nodes.label: Ferulic Acid
nodes.summary: 0.5% combined with 15% vitamin C and 1% vitamin E protected skin against solar-simulated UV damage (erythema, sunburn cells, thymine dimers, cytokines).

nodes.label: Melatonin
nodes.summary: Further improved photoprotection when co-applied with vitamins C and E.

nodes.label: Thymine Dimers
nodes.summary: UV DNA damage prevented by vitamin C/E combinations and green tea.

nodes.label: Two-Photon Fluorescence Imaging
nodes.summary: Laser microscopy showing UV generates many free radicals in the stratum corneum.

nodes.label: Skin Lipid Peroxidation Tape Assay
nodes.summary: Tape-removed skin lipids exposed to UV to measure antioxidant protection; showed vitamin E/emblica synergy and pro-oxidant behavior of some materials.
